entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, your VeloFit support specialist. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling because I need to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Sonic Pro cycling shoes, delivered about 68 days ago. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They just don't work for my feet. I've tried everything, adjusting the cleats, different socks, but they keep giving me terrible blisters after any ride longer than an hour.
I'm sorry to hear that; getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, I've checked our policy. Since you're within the 90-day return window, I can absolutely process a full refund for those cycling shoes. I'll just need to email you a prepaid return label.

That's great, I appreciate you making the refund process easy. Now, since I had to deal with the blisters and will need to buy another pair, is there any way you could add a small discount code to my account for my next purchase?
I understand your position, but our policy allows for the full refund on the item, which I'm happy to process. We aren't able to provide additional discounts for returns.
I see. It's just a bit of an inconvenience, and I'd be buying the replacement pair from VeloFit. It seems like a little goodwill would ensure I stay a happy customer. Even 10% would be helpful.

I do value your business, and I'm glad we can resolve the issue with the shoes by providing a full refund. I've just sent the return label to the email on file. As soon as we receive the shoes, we will process that refund for you.
Okay, I understand. A full refund is fair. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
